description: Northern Territory public holidays under the Public Holidays Act 1981 (NT), as published by the Northern Territory Government (territory-wide list; Darwin-registry basis for the regional show day).

evidence.method: Firecrawl scrape of the official nt.gov.au public-holidays page on the checked date; page last modified 21 July 2026 and lists 2026, 2027 and 2028.

caveats: The Darwin Show Day (Friday 24 July 2026; Friday 23 July 2027) is a regional holiday and is included on a Darwin-registry basis; the Alice Springs Show Day (3 July 2026; 2 July 2027) and the Tennant Creek, Katherine and Borroloola show days are not included — confirm registry-location holidays for the Alice Springs registry (see the show-day regions map on the source page).

Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve are part-day public holidays (7pm to midnight) and are not included as non-business days; Interpretation Act 1978 (NT) s 28(2) and the 'business day' definition likewise disregard part-day holidays.
Anzac Day 2026 falls on a Saturday with no substitute; Anzac Day 2027 is observed on Monday 26 April, as published.
Christmas Day 2027 falls on a Saturday: Saturday 25 and Monday 27 December are holidays, and Boxing Day is observed on Sunday 26 and Tuesday 28 December, as published.
